subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB528; data-model design D24). SR2 states TWO obligations and only the first was ever answered. MEMBERSHIP - 'Character-string-1 shall consist of an allowable combination of characters used as picture symbols' - is PictureAnalyzer's whitelist loop (COBOL0808). The COMBINATION half - 'The allowable combinations of symbols for a PICTURE clause are specified in 13.18.40.6, Precedence rules' - is now PictureComposition: Table 10 as a 24x24 DATA table in the standard's own printed order, and symbol ORDER decided by assigning each occurrence its Table-10 role and requiring an 'x' for EVERY ordered pair (13.18.40.6: an 'x' means the column symbol 'may precede (but not necessarily immediately)' the row symbol, so the relation binds non-adjacent pairs). The two position-ambiguous kinds - a non-floating '+'/'-' and a non-floating currency symbol, each of which has a leftmost and a rightmost role - are SEARCHED rather than guessed, and SR24 bounds each to one occurrence so the search is at most four assignments. A violation is COBOL1935 naming the offending pair. Table10DriftTests re-parses all 576 cells plus the 163-mark glyph count out of specs/ISO_COBOL.md every build; the markdown was itself verified cell-for-cell against the canonical PDF (printed folios 459-460) by geometry. Measured before enabling over all 730 distinct PICTURE strings in the corpora and after over all 1339 conformance+NIST programs: the only rejections were an authentic NIST card error (IX110A's PIC P, corrected) and the deliberate format-2 negatives. retired-witness: unit:PictureCompositionTests.APrecedenceViolation_IsCOBOLNET1935 (the same witness, re-spelled when the diagnostic code prefix became COBOL#### (kb/Work PB3575); the new spelling is recorded in its place)
